verdict.rationale: Whether a voice AI platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Vapi's own source is available under an open license. The only open-source mention is Pipecat, which belongs to Daily.co, not Vapi, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
